what_it_does: This paper presents EdgeDiff, a specialized processor for running diffusion models (the technique behind AI image generation) on mobile and edge devices. Diffusion models work by gradually removing noise from random static over many iterative steps to create images. EdgeDiff makes this fast and energy-efficient by using two key techniques: mixed-precision arithmetic (using different numbers of bits for different parts of the calculation) and reordered group quantization (reorganizing how numbers are rounded to smaller, faster representations). The accelerator is optimized for multi-modal models that process both text and images, reducing energy per inference to 418.4 millijoules.
